SELECT q.question_grade_level AS gradeLevel, q.question_grade AS grade, COUNT(*) AS questionCount FROM edu_question q
AND NOT (q.question_grade_level IS NULL AND q.question_grade IS NULL)
AND q.question_status = #{status}
AND q.question_status != 0
AND (q.question_owner_user_id IS NULL OR q.question_owner_user_id = #{scope.ownerPredicate})
GROUP BY q.question_grade_level, q.question_grade ORDER BY gradeLevel ASC, grade ASC
